ValidationRule.description: Project 790, Req 3: requires a Primary Proposal before Send To Order Management when proposal approval applies. AMS owners in the approval-exempt public group are excluded through Exempt_From_Proposal_Approval__c.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Send To Order Management"), Proposal_Approval_Required__c, NOT(Exempt_From_Proposal_Approval__c), ISBLANK(Primary_Proposal__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity has no Primary Proposal set. Open the Quote (Proposal) you want to use for this order and mark it as the Primary Proposal before sending to Order Management.
